update CHB_AGENT_PRD_SUB
SEND_STATUS = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03', submit_time = now()
trim(REGIST_SEQNO) = #{regist.registSeqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select:
SELECT distinct(a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE) code, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME name, b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME shortName, a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE hidCode from CHB_AGENT_PRD_SUB a left join CHB_AGENT_INSTITUTION_SUB b on a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE = b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE
AND (a.AGENT_INSTITUTION_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or b.AGENT_INSTITUTION_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{agentInstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

SELECT distinct(PROD_ID) code, PROD_NAME name, PROD_NAME shortName, PROD_ID hidCode FROM CHB_AGENT_PRD_SUB
AND (PROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or PROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

SELECT distinct(PROD_REGIST_CODE) code FROM CHB_AGENT_PRD_SUB
AND PROD_REGIST_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{prodRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
